In 1790, Congress initially allowed copyright protections for a maximum of 28 years. That number doubled in 1909 to 56 years.  In 1976, Congress passed a new copyright law that meant works published between 1922 and 1977 would be protected for 75 years.  Those 1922 works entered the public domain in 1998, and 1923 works were supposed to enter the public domain in 1999.
